environment.note: spectra are synthetic and deterministic; HyperSpy ran without numba (non-accelerated paths, identical results)

plural.note: J = I0 ifft(fft(Z/I0) exp(fft(S)/I0)) on a 8192 circular grid, cropped; truth S is the single-scattering counts, S x Z/I0 is what Fourier-log returns

fourierRatio.note: exSpy's Gaussian is a density per eV (A=1, sum over channels = 1/scale), so the result is the planted edge smoothed by the Gaussian AND multiplied by 1/scale: interior of fr-fixed-threshold-6 equals smoothed truth / scale to 3 %
